content: Ecto array+GIN pattern (confirmed by hexdocs Ecto.Migration and fly.io Phoenix Files 'Tag All the Things'): migration uses add :tags, {:array, :string} then create index("games", [:tags], using: :gin) (or raw execute SQL). Schema mirrors with field :tags, {:array, :string}, default: []. Query containment with fragment("? = ANY(?)", ^tag, g.tags) for single tag or fragment("? && ?", g.tags, ^tag_list) (Postgres array overlap operator) for any-of-N matching, both GIN-index-accelerated. No join table needed until a tag needs its own metadata (matches PROJECT.md decision).
